CASE_STUDY_DETAILS.headline: Repeat drivetrain repairs on a Model Y

CASE_STUDY_DETAILS.situation: A Bay Area owner reported recurring powertrain warnings after multiple service visits within the first year.
CASE_STUDY_DETAILS.defectSummary: Same drivetrain fault logged on four repair orders; cumulative days out of service exceeded the Song-Beverly guideline.

CASE_STUDY_DETAILS.outcomeSummary: Manufacturer repurchase with fees shifted. Client paid nothing out of pocket for legal work.
